title: voacanga foetida
intro: Voacanga foetida, commonly known as the 'ivoi' or 'iboga' plant, is a tropical evergreen tree native to West and Central Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, providing various health benefits such as improved mental clarity, reduced anxiety, and increased energy levels. The therapeutic actions of Voacanga foetida include its ability to act as a stimulant, a sedative, and an anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include voacamine and voacangine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to have potential in treating neurodegenerative diseases and addiction.
